messages:
Gina: Heads-up  opened a small PR to add an 'Edgecases' note to Optimize short-sequence guidance. Found a customer case where prefetch + q4 caused token shift on very short templated prompts. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1147
Paul: Oof. Can you capture the reproduce steps? We should include a tiny diagnostic snippet so support can triage quickly.
Gina: Added reproduce steps + a minimal repro payload in the PR: a 12-token templated prompt with placeholders that cause tokenization differences. Snippet in doc: 
```json
{"prompt": "Hi {name}, your code: {code_snip}"}
```
Arjun: Add a one-liner rule: "Avoid q4_* for templated prompts under 24 tokens; prefer q8_0 or fp16 fallback". Also mention that KV-prefetch can mask tokenization drift if cache warms incorrectly.
Gina: Done  added the rule and a short explanation of how warmed cache can hide alignment issues during canary runs.
Heather: Support asked for a quick triage command they can run from Console to spot affected routes. Suggest: `SELECT route, avg(seq_len), misalignment_rate FROM route_quality WHERE misalignment_rate > 0.01` (pseudo).
Gina: Added that pseudo-query and a small playbook item: "If misalignment_rate > 1% then rollback quant or disable prefetch; run synth_tests.py".
Paul: For the synth_tests.py please include a minimal public-friendly helper, not internal code. Also add a short note about SDK version compatibility for the helper (py SDK >=0.10).
Gina: Yep, I sanitized the helper and included a compatibility footnote referencing legacy BatchClient for <0.10.
Arjun: Tiny wording tweak: make it clear this is an "edge-case for templated, low-entropy prompts" — many readers may think it's general.
Gina: Updated heading and intro paragraph to emphasize "templated low-entropy prompts (<=24 tokens)".
docs-bot: @Gina created ticket JIRA-OPT-754 (docs: short-seq edgecase note + synth helper + triage query) :bell:
Heather: Could we add a recommended canary pattern specifically for templated routes? Maybe 2%->10%->50% with strict exact-match checks at each step.
Paul: Good idea. Add conservative percentages and exact-match thresholds: fail if exact-match delta > 0.3%.
Gina: Added templated-route canary: 2%->10%->50% with checks on exact-match delta and misalignment_rate. Included JSON: 
```json
{"templated_canary": ["2%","10%","50%"], "checks": ["exact_match_delta < 0.3%","misalignment_rate < 1%"]}
```
Arjun: Also include a note to run the 2k representative promptset if you suspect regressions; templated sets can be smaller but still need enough samples to be meaningful.
Gina: Added guidance: for templated routes 500-1k samples may suffice, but run full 2k when in doubt. Added synth_prompts_templated.py example.
Heather: Will do a short copyedit and then we can merge once Paul signs off on the diagnostic snippets. Aiming for tomorrow morning.
Gina: Thanks all  I left follow-up comments in the PR. Will update after Paul reviews.
